query:
SELECT 'lowest_fill' AS case_id,jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) AS rows FROM (SELECT i.snapshot_date,p.product_name,i.fill_rate FROM commerce.inventory i JOIN commerce.products p USING(product_id) WHERE i.snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM commerce.inventory) ORDER BY i.fill_rate,i.product_id LIMIT 10)x
UNION ALL SELECT 'stock',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM(SELECT snapshot_date,SUM(stock_on_hand) AS value FROM commerce.inventory WHERE snapshot_date='2022-12-31' GROUP BY snapshot_date)x
UNION ALL SELECT 'mean_fill',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM(SELECT i.snapshot_date,p.category,AVG(i.fill_rate) AS value FROM commerce.inventory i JOIN commerce.products p USING(product_id) WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM commerce.inventory) GROUP BY i.snapshot_date,p.category)x
UNION ALL SELECT 'history',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM(SELECT snapshot_date,SUM(stock_on_hand) AS value FROM commerce.inventory WHERE snapshot_date>='2022-01-01' AND snapshot_date<'2023-01-01' GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY snapshot_date)x
UNION ALL SELECT 'received',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM(SELECT snapshot_date,SUM(units_received) AS value FROM commerce.inventory WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM commerce.inventory) GROUP BY snapshot_date)x
UNION ALL SELECT 'stockout',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM(SELECT i.snapshot_date,p.category,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.stockout_flag IS TRUE)::numeric/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM commerce.inventory i JOIN commerce.products p USING(product_id) WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM commerce.inventory) GROUP BY i.snapshot_date,p.category)x
